record.site_desc: The study site is in the northwest corner of the Encanto Golf Course in Phoenix, Arizona. The site is close to a weather station managed by the Arizona Meteorological Network (AZMET; https://cals.arizona.edu/AZMET/).  The soil is well-drained Mohall clay loam that has undergone several decades of soil and water treatments. The low-density urban landscape surrounding the golf park consists of single-family residences, commercial areas, streets, and parking lots.

grp_location.location_comment: Located with an open, flat, turf grass area in Phoenix, Arizona.

grp_igbp.igbp_comment: Turf grass management at Encanto Golf Course includes varying treatments in fairways and rough areas, using warm-season bermudagrass (Cynodon dactylon) and overseeding with ryegrass (Lolium perenne) to maintain grass cover during the cool season. While turf grass is nearly continuous in cover, a few scattered palms are found in rough areas and trees line nearby streets.
